meta.title: Vista Eye Specialist — Digital Transformation Roadmap
meta.premise: Planned on CDS being appointed for all nine RFP scopes from 1 November 2026; delivery team defined by role, with named people assigned at mobilisation. Everything in the retainer scopes is covered by the retainer — no add-on charges for reaching the targets set here.

objectives.name: One lead definition, one cost per patient
objectives.why: Today there are five different lead counts, the website conversion metric has been redefined twice, and no revenue is recorded against any campaign. Until one lead definition exists and cost per booked appointment and cost per attended visit are reported side by side, nothing else can be judged fairly.
objectives.measure: One reconciled lead ledger (platform → Respond.io → booking system) published monthly from Month 2; cost per booked appointment reported from Month 2 (baseline RM182, Jan–Aug 2026) and cost per attended visit from the moment the booking-system link is live.
objectives.owner: Analytics Lead · sponsor: Head of Digital Solutions

objectives.name: A new website that is fast, trilingual and built to convert
objectives.why: 101 location URLs for 16 branches, no consent layer, 3.08 MB homepage, 12–38 serious accessibility violations per template, 0 posts in the sitemap since 2024. The current site cannot pass the RFP's own acceptance criteria. One site, not two: the same website ranks separately for every page it has, and a Happenings section carries news and updates without a second domain or a second KKLIU licence.
objectives.measure: Headless site live 22 January 2027 on AWS Malaysia: 16 canonical branch pages, EN/BM/ZH with hreflang, CMP live, Lighthouse ≥ 90, WCAG 2.2 AA audited, CWV field p75 Good by Month 6.

objectives.name: Turn the enquiries Vista already gets into booked visits
objectives.why: Unpaid enquiries book at 14.4%, paid at 1.5%. Warm→Hot sits at 21–33% every month; the AI assistant cannot answer a price question and the auto-close manufactures 'Inactive' losses.
objectives.measure: Paid Ads booking rate from 1.5% to ≥ 4% by Month 6 and ≥ 6% by Month 12; Warm→Hot ≥ 40% by Month 6; zero after-hours red-flag cases unread past 9 am next day.
objectives.owner: Account Manager with Vista CS lead · Analytics Lead

objectives.name: Be found for cataract, LASIK and every centre
objectives.why: Organic Search is the best-engaged channel and the one nobody reports on. Content arrives in batches and stopped in May 2026. AI-referral traffic has started (282 sessions) with no one measuring it.
objectives.measure: Organic sessions +40% on the post-launch baseline by Month 12; 52 medically reviewed articles; ≥ 60% of tracked keywords on page 1; local-pack top-3 for priority centre × service pairs; AI visibility on ≥ 5 engines by Month 12.

objectives.name: Put media money where the bookings come from
objectives.why: The annual media budget is allocated on Google 'conversions' that are 23–52% PMax, bought at a fraction of the cost of a real enquiry, and Meta 'results' that book at 1.5%. The cheapest channel, TikTok, has no plan at all.
objectives.measure: Every campaign optimised to a CRM-verified booking signal by Month 4; cost per appointment −25% by Month 12 versus the Month-4 baseline; TikTok and LinkedIn decided on pilot evidence, not opinion.

objectives.name: Keep it fixed — one monthly meeting that closes actions
objectives.why: 345 open action items with no closure state and monthly reports without analysis. Findings recur because nobody owns closing them.
objectives.measure: Monthly strategy meeting with pre-read 2 days before and minutes 1 day after; action closure ≥ 90%; quarterly SteerCo with market research; Command Centre live at go-live.
objectives.owner: Programme Manager · Head of Digital Solutions

phases.name: Mobilise
phases.gate: Gate 0 — access confirmed, credentials rotated, budget shifts frozen
phases.summary: Two weeks to take over every account and asset, freeze measurement changes, and sit down with the Vista team for a joint strategy session: Vista knows its patients and services, CDS knows the digital side, and the plan is agreed together before anything is built.

phases.name: Audit, baseline & Discovery
phases.gate: Gate 1 (20 Nov) Discovery · Gate 2 (27 Nov) Design · Day 45 (16 Dec) roadmap & baselines
phases.summary: A full audit with the access CDS did not have before, so the baseline for every target is set on complete data. Measurement plan, single lead definition, GA4 rebuild, Respond.io clean-up, SEO and AI-visibility baselines, site structure and design approved. Social posting and the first small campaigns run in parallel from Month 1.

phases.name: Build the website & tracking
phases.gate: Week 9 (1 Jan) feature complete · Gate 5 (15 Jan) UAT · Go-live Fri 22 Jan 2027
phases.summary: Headless build on Storyblok + Next.js on AWS Malaysia with server-side tagging and CMP; content migration and redirects; paid media restructured onto the new landing pages.

phases.name: Hypercare & CNY
phases.gate: Gate 6 (19 Feb) hypercare exit · post-launch baseline locked 26 Feb
phases.summary: Four weeks of intensive stabilisation through Chinese New Year (6–7 Feb). Post-launch KPI baseline captured; floors become binding from Month 5.

phases.name: Optimise
phases.summary: CRO on the live site, Eye Carnival on a fully tagged funnel, lead-handling redesign with Vista CS, local SEO across 16 centres, content at cadence, GEO on five engines.

phases.name: Scale & renew
phases.gate: SteerCo 3 (Jul) · renewal terms tabled 30 Jul · Month-12 review & SteerCo 4 (Oct)
phases.summary: Scale what the evidence supports (TikTok, branch-level local campaigns, Open House), retire what it does not, and close Year 1 with the Year-2 plan and renewal decision made three months early.
